SELECT CASE WHEN channel = 'Online' THEN 'Online' ELSE 'Store' END AS ChannelGroup,
       avg(TransactionValue) AS AvgTransactionValue,
       count() AS TransactionCount
FROM (
    SELECT 'Online' AS channel, SalesOrderNumber AS OrderId, sum(SalesAmount) AS TransactionValue
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY SalesOrderNumber
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.ChannelName AS channel, toString(s.SalesKey) AS OrderId, s.SalesAmount AS TransactionValue
    FROM retail.FactSales s
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimChannel c ON s.channelKey = c.ChannelKey
)
GROUP BY ChannelGroup
ORDER BY ChannelGroup
